items.title: Metro Bank puts itself up for sale three years after rescue deal
items.summary: Metro Bank has announced it is open to takeover bids in a move that could yield a substantial payout for its majority shareholder.

items.title: Clear Group acquires Essex construction specialist broker Blackhawk
items.summary: Clear Group has expanded its sector expertise by purchasing Westcliff-on-Sea based Blackhawk Insurance Services.

items.title: Zurich Insurance reports higher catastrophe losses as premium growth continues
items.summary: Zurich Insurance Group cited European storms for rising catastrophe losses in its third-quarter trading update, while posting higher gross written premiums across property and casualty operations.

items.title: Willis appoints Chris Mulligan global head of risk engineering
items.summary: Willis has named Chris Mulligan as its global head of risk engineering, effective January 1.

items.title: Jupiter Asset Management restructures client group as CCLA leadership departs
items.summary: Jupiter Asset Management has restructured its client relationship team while CCLA chief executive Peter Hugh Smith and chief operating officer Elizabeth Sheldon step down.

items.title: FCA issues warning over unauthorised clone firm using details of Wave Lending Limited
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has warned consumers against dealing with clone entities operating under the names wavelendinglimited.co.uk and wavelendingltd.com.
